notes: Paper derives decaying-DM constraints from 16 yr of INTEGRAL/SPI data. Pre-analysis hint of DarkPhoton is WRONG. Main particle-physics result (Fig 3) is the ALP-photon coupling g_agamma vs m_a (60 keV - 16 MeV) from the a->gamma-gamma line channel. Data points are approximate, reconstructed from the decay-rate limits (Fig 1 left) via Eq. 6: Gamma_2g = 0.755e-30*(g/1e-20)^2*(ma/100keV)^3 s^-1, since no numerical table of g_agamma is provided. The paper also gives an ALP-electron coupling g_ae bound (Fig 4, FSR channel, 1-200 MeV) and a sterile-neutrino sin^2(2theta) bound (Fig 5). This is an astrophysical decaying-DM bound, not a haloscope, so no local DM density is assumed (NFW profile used for D-factor).
